framework: Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts
subject: ELA
textFidelity: Standard codes are verbatim. Standard text is faithful to the published standards; longer standards are abridged to their leading clause for display in a mastery map. Verify against the source URL before any public-facing use.
note: CCSS publishes high school ELA in 9-10 and 11-12 grade bands rather than by grade. Because mastery is permanent in Supernova, assigning an entire band to both of its grades would leave every 10th and 12th grader with a pre-mastered standard set. Each band is therefore split by strand cluster: grades 9 and 11 carry the Key Ideas and Details standards, grades 10 and 12 carry Craft and Structure plus Integration of Knowledge. Standards naming American literature and US foundational documents are assigned to grade 11 (American Literature), where they belong.
